prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high-fidelity desktop Add Transaction screen for Balancebook. The attached approved Transactions image is the mandatory visual reference for shell, typography, colors and density. Show a single full widescreen desktop interface, front-on edge-to-edge, no device frame, collage or perspective.
This is one of six TYPE-SPECIFIC STATES of ONE consistent form, not a new visual direction. Keep exact same dark graphite NOC/SOC operational style: narrow 200px left sidebar, 58px top nav, fine gray panel lines, compact typography, tabular money, restrained blue active controls, nearly square corners. Preserve both top and left nav with Transactions selected and Dashboard/Scheduled/Reports visible, top + Add Transaction button, Sep 05, 2026 and Account menu. Sidebar bottom sample status Synced 11:42, Pending changes 0, Conflicts 0, Last backup Today 02:00. No colorful decorative icons, gradients, giant cards or charts.
Main content shared grid: header "Add Transaction" and small "Back to transactions" link plus "SAMPLE DATA · REVIEW MOCKUP". Under header a compact TRANSACTION TYPE segmented selector with EXACTLY five choices: Expense | Income | Transfer | Debt Payment | Balance Adjustment. No top-level Refund. Under this selector, left form ~65% of content width and right "Review before saving" panel ~35%. Layout should feel like a mature compact operations form with clearly aligned field labels above bordered inputs. No wizard, no giant numbers, no oversized whitespace, no fake ledger table underneath. Fill forms with sample values given below so effects can be inspected.
Logical form order: transaction type, account or accounts, then amount/date and type-specific fields, optional notes, optional attachments. Always show date input Sep 05, 2026. NEVER include a transaction Name/Title/Description field or required freeform naming. Optional Notes is allowed. Account/payee names remain normal.
Right preview uses a compact exact table Account / Current / Change / After save, then small reporting summary using plain language. Mark preview "Not saved". At bottom of left form use Cancel secondary button and prominent compact blue "Save transaction" button, one deliberate save; no extra confirmation checkbox, no Save & New, no scheduled toggle. Helper "Changes apply when you save." No automatic financial mutation or fake success message.
Expense and Income require one selected account, positive magnitude amount input, date, payee autocomplete, exactly one category dropdown. Category suggestions may show small hint. Small "Create payee" and "Create category" links may accompany those fields. Optional attachment strip "Add receipt or file". No split categories.
Transfer, Debt Payment and Balance Adjustment have SYSTEM-GENERATED payee and reporting bucket read-only; do not force manual payee/category fields for these types. Attachments optional all forms, no OCR result automatically saved. Do not show developer/database/internal implementation details.
Exact visual fidelity: genuine readable English UI text, aligned numbers, no clipping; neutral text for current balances, green positive signed changes and restrained red negative signed changes; no green styling for unsigned payment totals. Keep sample data figures exact.

Review header "Expense"; Account Everyday Checking current +$3,450.00 change -$86.42 after save +$3,363.58. Payee Walmart; Category Groceries; Reporting "Spent +$86.42". No income claim.
